sources.retrieval_status: Original AMS PDF returned HTTP 403; full proof not inspected.
sources.inspection: The theorem is independently recorded in K3 and Yagasaki Fact 2.1.

sources.title: W. K. Mason, The space of all self-homeomorphisms of a two-cell which fix the cell's boundary is an absolute retract (1971)

sources.title: Robert Cauty, Un espace métrique linéaire qui n'est pas un rétracte absolu (1994)
sources.inspection: Bibliographic abstract and Cauty 2005 supporting discussion; no independent reconstruction of the counterexample.

sources.title: William E. Haver, Locally contractible spaces that are absolute neighborhood retracts (1973)
sources.inspection: Full text not obtained; sufficient criterion motivates a hypothesis disproved directly by the Baire argument. No positive ANR conclusion depends on this source.

sources.inspection: Theorems 3.2–3.3, printed pp. 392–394, local-to-global ANR in separable metric category; statement and proof inspected.
